title: Build resumable collection and reproducible offline analysis
description:
## Scope

Turn the study scaffold into a runner with exact preflight manifests, a complete cache identity, bounded collection, and trustworthy metrics.

Fake-engine integration specs prove no-network preflight, safe resume, complete matrix accounting, faithful response storage, and deterministic reports.
